verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents installing and deploying the service on your own Linux server, which lets a user control where vault data physically lives. The pack has no evidence of choosing a hosted cloud region (e.g. US vs EU), so residency control comes only through the heavier self-hosting route. Missing for 10: documented choice of cloud region or data residency, residency or compliance documentation, independent corroboration of self-hosted residency in practice.
